environment: disposable ARM64 Linux VM, 1 CPU, 2 GiB; VM removed after test
coverage: Runs all five existing placement test groups, plus checks that a future observation produces eligible/stale. Updated freshness group covers invalid/negative time, nonpositive TTL, future, TTL boundary and i64 maximum. Old predicate is the negative control.
limits: Pure placement source-unity fixture; no current host measurement, runtime integration, authenticated clock, resource reservation, macOS or fleet execution. Legacy CLJK freshness still has the older behavior. The native candidate intentionally rejects future times rather than assuming a clock-skew allowance.
